key_concepts: Electromagnetic waves are created by vibrations between electric and magnetic fields
A changing electric field produces a magnetic field
A changing magnetic field produces an electric field
EM waves carry energy as they propagate
EM waves can travel through vacuum without a medium
EM waves travel at 3x10^8 m/s in vacuum
The electromagnetic spectrum arranges EM waves by frequency and wavelength
The EM spectrum includes radio waves, microwaves, infrared, visible light, ultraviolet, X-
Radio waves have the longest wavelength and lowest frequency
Gamma rays have the shortest wavelength and highest frequency and energy
Visible light ranges from red to violet, with red having the longest wavelength and violet
